proposal.condition: target selected among factual errors by error and entropy
proposal.route_birth: activate a near-zero closed gate only when source event has unused top-k capacity

tree_backup.interpretation: one scalar is recursively propagated from each descendant; one route alternative is sampled from q at each state, not exhaustive over all candidates

virtual_update.suffix: layers strictly after the last forced swap plus deepest event head
virtual_update.forced_route_indices_stable: all layers through the last forced swap are frozen during its suffix update

interpretation_note: A sampled swap is rerun through all deeper layers, and only scalar option values are propagated back; This is a frozen diagnostic, not trained accuracy, an AdamW update, or an exhaustive route expectation.
